mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `shop_manager` WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY sort ASC

SELECT s.id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, s.qualification_cert AS qualificationCert, sa.apply_result AS applyResult, MAX(sm.head_manager) AS canCancel FROM `shop_manager` sm INNER JOIN `shop` s ON sm.shop_id = s.id INNER JOIN `settlement_application` sa ON sa.shop_id = s.id AND sa.apply_result = 1 WHERE sm.phone = #{phone} AND s.delete_time IS NULL AND (s.shop_status IS NULL OR s.shop_status != 2) GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.qualification_cert, sa.apply_result ORDER BY s.id DESC
